result.reason: The clause appropriately covers Affiliates and contractors and removes revocation at Vendor’s sole discretion, but it does not permit transfer to a successor and does not ensure that a subscription licence may be terminated only for uncured material breach; the open-ended reference to Section 13.3 could allow broader revocation. It also does not address perpetual, irrevocable treatment for any paid-up licence. Added concepts such as worldwide scope, Documentation, internal-business-purpose restrictions, Authorized Users, and suspension rights go beyond what is necessary and may alter unrelated commercial intent. The duplicated section number and the ambiguous phrase “irrevocable (during the applicable subscription term)” reduce drafting quality.
